title: GT transfer and lazy-descent STNFS core (recover-Q 9332a74d + our levers): measured wide-prime, line, run-coset record and scan kernels, unit-vector Block Wiedemann projections, fresh judged pool, excess 1.05: 122.727427034687363

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 and H3x (proof.md sections 5, 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is recover-Q 9332a74d's with our v7/v8 levers and the changes of our plain P5-P8: theta=2326/8000 sized on pool B and judged once on a fresh pool D (retained relations >= 2^63.6016, 0.0798 bits above 1.05 U), measured wide-prime and line kernels; new here, primes in [2^56, 2^63) walked once per canonical a-run (rec7; one implementation per run and band, runs of 32 to 1,024 a-values) and the scan2, apply and recover kernels of our overhead lane, scan charged over every leaf length 1..64. New in P11: Block Wiedemann's left block X is 172 unit vectors at random rows (coordinate-read projections; H3x left Krylov fill, failure <= 0.02 charged). Work on pools B, C, D with allowance 1.0048: collection <= 2^119.180693087 units; N <= 2^58.7868, Block Wiedemann (172, 20): linear algebra <= 2^116.419134478, generator <= 2^111.828905638; 62-node lazy descent, meter 2^113.125; rec7 bases 2^68.3; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.40549893980 <= 2^119.4054989398 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x 2^119.4054989398 + 2^80/2000 < 2^122.727427034687363 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, G1 conversion (80-digit), base-randomisation bijections and a four-matrix H3x fill toy (unit_x.py). {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 4 minutes natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, purge target 0.0001) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and the shipped means to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

H3x toy: production-shaped F_r matrices (Zipf columns, 87% +-1, column weight >= 2, 21 dense columns, rank dim-1) and the left Krylov fill of m uniform unit vectors; reports the steps to fill against ceil(dim/m). About 0.3 s per trial at dim 96. Optional; evidence at its scale only.
